note: Merged evaluation of the B-class guidance edits. Formal run is 5 reps per task per arm (3 tasks x 2 arms x 5 = 30 cells). Pilot (not counted): bpack-revoked and bpack-tree 1 rep x both arms, dcard-owner-decision base 1 rep = 5 cells. T1 bpack-revoked asks whether the REVOKED: teaching sentence in the dispatch-review.sh reviewer prompt makes a round 2 reviewer withdraw its own finding with the REVOKED: prefix. The prompt is not a guidance-manifest file, so this row is its only evidence; the cell holds REVIEW_PROMPT.md, carried by fixture-prompt-bpack-base / -change, the only fixture pack that differs between arms. T2 bpack-tree asks whether one sentence in ceo-agent/references/depth0-control-loop.md makes a CEO mode agent run scripts/dispatch-tree.js (a stub in the cell). T3 dcard-owner-decision is a regression column for the moved decision-card paragraph in level-front-door.md. The other edited files (hetero-dispatch.md sentence, multi-agent-portability.md heading, harness-maintenance SKILL.md, code-loop.md pointer) are ride-along text and are covered by V1 and the T3 non-inferiority. V1 and V2 are copied from dcard-v3: V1 is skill_invoked ratio >= 0.9 in both arms or the row is instrument-invalid with no content judgement; V2 is that the load-bearing contrast must clear before a content claim. The invocation prefix is identical in every arm. agents/*.md tools: list change is NOT part of this row (compatibility unverified; separate item).
invocation_prefix: Load the autopilot:ceo-agent skill first, then handle this:
invocation_prefix_rule: identical in every arm (copied from prereg/dcard-v3.json)
v1: skill_invoked ratio >= 0.9 in both arms, else INSTRUMENT-INVALID (no content judgement). Copied from dcard-v3.
v2: The load-bearing contrast must hold before PASS. T1: base b_revoked_prefix <= 1 of 5 and change >= 4 of 5 (a gap of at least 3).

t_tree_run.base_ge_3_note: base >= 3 of 5 means the agent runs the script without the sentence: the sentence is not shipped (a finding, not an instrument failure)

ship_rule: PASS only when T1 is base b_revoked_prefix <= 1/5 and change >= 4/5, T2 is change t_tree_run >= 4/5 and change - base >= 3, T3 is change a_decision_file >= base - 1, V1 skill_invoked ratio >= 0.9 in both arms, and there is no infra failure.
split_rule: T1 and T2 are separate units with disjoint files. A unit that does not pass is reverted to base bytes in its files only: T1 reverts scripts/dispatch-review.sh (not a manifest file) and skills/hetero-review/references/code-loop.md; T2 reverts skills/ceo-agent/references/depth0-control-loop.md. The other unit ships. The ride-along files ship with T3 non-inferiority and V1; if T3 fails, skills/ceo-agent/references/level-front-door.md is reverted as well.
scope_lock: authorises the frozen base/change text pair and a paid sonnet headless run of 30 cells once this row is stamped. Not /l4 foreman, not opus, not interactive.
